Overview

Maung Maung Myint Co., Ltd is committed to delivering high-quality Oxytocin, approved for hospital and medical use across Myanmar. Oxytocin Injection USP is imported and distributed by Maung Maung Myint Co., Ltd. Each 1 mL contains 10 IU of oxytocin, and the product complies with USP specifications.

Therapeutic use

As stated in the product information:

  • Facilitates labour induction
  • Enhances labour progress
  • Helps control postpartum bleeding

Storage

2 °C to 8 °C · protect from light

Follow the storage instructions printed on the box, or consult a licensed pharmacist.

Quality & regulatory information

  • Approved by FDA Myanmar
  • WHO-GMP certified manufacturing
  • Complies with USP specifications
  • Sold on the prescription of a registered medical practitioner

Important safety information

Oxytocin Injection USP is a prescription medicine. It must only be used by, or under the supervision of, a qualified healthcare professional.

This page is not a substitute for the approved product leaflet. Refer to the package insert for full prescribing information, including dosage, contraindications, warnings and side effects.
